Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Svinninge
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A contemporary interpretation of a traditional villa with a stone foundation, wooden frame, wooden facade, and simple gable roof with exposed rafter motif, designed to integrate sensitively into a forested hillside site.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Hersbyholm
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A pool pavilion comprising two connected structures with CLT wood walls, laminated timber frame, and a floating corten steel roof, designed to integrate with the garden vegetation over time.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Klövsjö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: New construction of a mountain cottage with barns, complementary buildings, and wine cellar.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Fågelbro
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A comprehensive renovation and expansion of a 1990s villa featuring a standing wood facade, tarred pine roof, larger windows positioned high toward the ceiling, and a continuous wood floor throughout, with new interior volumes creating varied ceiling heights and improved light.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Dalarö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A modern vacation house with guest house, garage, and sauna that terraces down a hillside with natural stone foundations, cedar wood facades, and iron railings in natural tones to harmonize with the surrounding archipelago landscape.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Bastuholmen
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new villa construction project in Täby, Sweden.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Gudö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A newly constructed villa completed in 2022.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Astrea
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: New construction of a pool and pool house completed in 2015.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Kroklada
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A modern reinterpretation of a traditional Öland barn (kroklada) built as a vacation house using timber-frame construction (skiftesverk) clad in untreated pine panel, with shuttered openings designed to allow filtered light.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Erstavik
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: An addition to an existing villa featuring a long, slender volume clad in warm-toned gray-glazed pine in two shades, designed to harmonize with the forest backdrop and connect visually and physically to the original house through varied ceiling heights and sightlines.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Gräsö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new vacation house (fritidshus) designed for a private client on the island of Gräsö.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Gandul
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new pool and pool house built in Djursholm for a private client.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Lövåsen
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new timber mountain cabin (fjällstuga) designed with historical reference to the classical North Swedish square courtyard farm (fyrkantsgård) building tradition.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Singö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new villa and guest house project in Åkersberga, currently under construction.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Stocksund
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new construction pool and pool house project completed in 2019.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Rödlöga
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A vacation house expansion and renovation with complementary buildings, constructed using open-diffusion timber frame principles with wood fiber insulation and linseed oil interior finishes to blend harmoniously into the sensitive coastal cultural landscape.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Muskö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new vacation house (fritidshus) designed as a private residential project.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Oboen
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: An extension to an existing villa including a pool and pool area.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Stavsnäs by
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A vacation house replacement featuring a reinterpreted archipelago villa with symmetrical cross-shaped plan, thin flying saddle roof, a separate pavilion veranda angled toward the water, constructed with solid materials, wood fiber insulation, wood frame construction, and custom carpentry with red exterior color inspired by local medieval buildings.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Ljungdalen
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A contemporary timber mountain house designed for a large family, reinterpreting traditional Härjedalen architecture and built with isotimber construction.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Furusund
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A new vacation house with guest house and sauna designed as a private residential project.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Kyrksjöbacken
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A fully-equipped rental home of approximately 20 square meters built according to Attefallsreglerna regulations, featuring traditional red-painted wooden cladding, linseed oil-painted pine windows, a low-pitched roof, a sleeping loft, and a 3.6-meter-high living room with windows positioned to frame views of surrounding apple trees.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Sprätthöken
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: An extension of a 1924 villa that was substantially renovated in the 1950s, designed to harmonize with the existing house through materials including grey rendered facade, wooden door details, copper roof trim, clay tile flooring, and wooden window frames.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Överby
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: Renovation and expansion of a vacation house with new pool and pool area.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Saltarö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A summer house on sloped waterfront terrain in the Stockholm archipelago with tiered interior half-levels following the steep topography, horizontal roofs, recessed corners creating multiple outdoor spaces, and a wooden pathway connecting the road through the house via passage and stairs to a dock.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Kristinelund
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A small vacation house with a timber frame of solid pine posts and hemp-lime insulation between the timbers, finished externally with Öland lime mortar and internally with exposed timber and large glass sections, with floors and terraces of flamed Öland limestone and roof of single-fired clay tiles, left untreated to age naturally.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Villa Westre
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A renovation of a 1970s villa featuring retained structural elements with new materials including oak, stone, and matte painted surfaces, enhanced natural light from skylights, and a new fireplace as a central gathering point.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Älgö
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A newly constructed villa in Stockholm's archipelago designed by Lowén Widman Arkitekter.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Yxlan
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A renovation and expansion of an early 20th-century vacation house in the Stockholm archipelago, featuring sustainable materials, restored timber facades, clay tile roofs, and new complementary buildings including a boathouse and guest house, designed to harmonize with the site's historical character and natural environment.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Styrmansgatan
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: Renovation of balcony railings that preserves the original character and design language while meeting current safety and building standards.

Lowén Widman Arkitekter.name: Munkvik - Rödlöga
Lowén Widman Arkitekter.description: A renovation and expansion of a vacation house complex comprising multiple low-pitched gabled volumes in Falun red with natural stone bases, clay tile roofs, and timber facades, designed as a cohesive family of buildings referencing local vernacular architecture of boathouses and cottages.
